Furthermore, the specific post-processing logic described in the notes (filling inside regions using corner voxel labeling) is not present in the provided code passages, which focus on mesh generation from voxel grids rather than occupancy grid post-processing. Therefore, the evidence does not support the claim regarding the source repository or author.

If the corner voxel belongs to an internal object rather than the true exterior, the outside label will be misidentified and the filling will be incorrect [S1, unofficial].

The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states that the 'outside' label is identified using the corner voxel (specifically `labels[0][0][0]`). It further states that the filling process sets all voxels that do not have this 'outside_label' to 1. Therefore, if the corner voxel belongs to an internal object (meaning its label is not the true exterior/background label), the algorithm will incorrectly identify that internal label as the 'outside' label. Consequently, the true exterior regions (which would have different labels) would be filled with 1, resulting in an incorrect filling. This aligns perfectly with the claim.
supported
